name: Hotel Kailas
why_special: Senior budget-mid hotel directly opposite the Kailasa Temple cave entrance — 30 cottage-style rooms across landscaped grounds, multi-cuisine restaurant. The only accommodation walking-distance to the caves.

name: MTDC Ellora Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's smaller Ellora property — basic A/C and non-A/C cottages, in-house restaurant, the value-rate alternative to Hotel Kailas at the cave gate.
